en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I decided to spend time today talking
about things with Gonta.

<CLT=cltMIND>Because Gonta is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Entomologist<CLT=cltMIND>,
I decided to ask him about his work.

Gonta, you really are impressive,
you know that?

G-Gonta nothing special. Gonta just listen
to what bugs say.
<CLT=cltMIND>He's always so humble...

<CLT=cltMIND>Sure, he discovers new insect species, but
he also develops cultivation methods...

<CLT=cltMIND>And he once discovered a parasitic worm that
was causing disease, and was praised as a hero.
You've saved so many lives, Gonta.

Yes, but gentlemen supposed to help
people.

Gonta gotta work even harder and
become true gentleman.
You know, Gonta, you say that, but...
I know how truly amazing you are.

I don't think you need to work so hard to
be a gentleman. You're already incredible.

B-But, Shuichi! Gonta must become
gentleman! For forest family!

The reason you developed your
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Entomologist<CLT=cltNORMAL> talent...

was *because* your forest family taught you
so much about insects and animals, right?
Yes, that right...

So you should be proud of that, Gonta.
No matter what anyone says.

Your forest family helped you develop
into the talented man you are today!
That all Gonta need...?

That's plenty, Gonta.
From now on...

As long as you work hard as the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate
Entomologist<CLT=cltNORMAL>, your family will accept you.
But...Gonta no help to anyone right now.

You are!
You saved me before, remember?
I almost fell down the staircase!
Oh!

Gonta...you're a more amazing person
than you think you are.
Sh-Shuichi!

Thank you!
Gonta eyes open now!

Gonta understand!
Gonta learn from you...

Gonta gonna get even better at talent
he got from forest family!

But...Gonta still gonna try to become
gentleman.
Why...?

At first, Gonta do it for forest family.
But now...
Gonta just wanna be gentleman.

Gonta wanna be nice, serious, refined,
polite gentleman.
That Gonta's goal now!

I see...
Then I think that's a great goal to have.
Yeah! Gonta work hard to reach goal!

<CLT=cltMIND>After a firm nod, Gonta's expression
softened and he looked at me...

Thank you so much, Shuichi. Gonta
understand a lot more cuz of you.
Gonta glad he meet Shuichi.

From now on, Gonta keep you and
everyone else safe...like true gentleman!

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta took my hand and squeezed it.
And I squeezed back.

<CLT=cltMIND>...There is a real bond here.
I believe it with all my heart.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Gonta's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've learned a new skill,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Wild Awakening<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta and I parted ways,
and I returned to my room.
